inherited_art_evidence.lesson: entry and public terrace visible; crescent amphitheatre impression => only reuse clarity, not geometry
inhabited city visible but miniature detached blocks
single gigantic arch displaced civic architecture
fragmented miniature city and dominating central road
mass-only studies too easily appear as shell or pavilion
real perforations worked technically; parallel bands hid city life
inhabited terraces visible but miniaturized; blank side wall; internal eye blocked by floors

design_zones.name: 北側都市展望室
design_zones.purpose: clear far destination of public procession

form_hypothesis.western_urban_strata: higher, nonuniform inhabited terraces integrated into occupied sculptural mass; not isolated thin arch
form_hypothesis.eastern_urban_strata: lower and deeper public culture/research frontage rather than repeating western housing
form_hypothesis.sky_void: central open-to-sky civic aperture, framed by used facades with independent far destination
form_hypothesis.arrival: clear southern foreground, no long bridge over primary sight line
form_hypothesis.bridge_rule: peripheral cross connectors that do not occlude the primary arrival-to-far-destination view

gates.name: design logic and 2D views
criteria: entry, active civic room, lived-in facades and far destination identifiable in annotated plan/section
at least two different urban programs evident

gates.name: lightweight real 3D geometry
criteria: front, oblique and side independently inspected under same camera + scale
no single shell/ring/band dominates in place of city
nontrivial inhabited urban depth and civic void both simultaneously legible
public approach sight line unobstructed in actual mesh

gates.name: interior experience
criteria: real inner viewpoint camera location disclosed
arrival, two occupied levels and far civic destination distinguishable
physically validated entry only when independent access QA is eventually run

gates.name: later engineering QA
criteria: independent 3D loader and geometry contact checks
no unsupported feet; historical collision ceiling unchanged
